Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.scene

Class GroupObject

java.lang.Object
io.jengacode.eduvideo.scene.SceneObject
io.jengacode.eduvideo.scene.GroupObject
Direct Known Subclasses:
CoordinatePlane, GraphObject, PanelObject
public class GroupObject extends SceneObject
Nested local coordinate system with inherited opacity and stable z ordering.

Enforces single ownership and rejects cycles. Children render in stable z-order inside the group transform; inherited opacity composes multiplicatively.
